meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把杂乱难懂的代码拆解重组成清晰结构,让它更易读易改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有写乱或过时的代码想理清结构又不想改变行为
copy.tagline_en: Break messy code into a clearer structure without changing what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your code feels tangled and you want cleaner structure without behavior changes

howto.what: 装上后可用 /refactor 命令:Claude 会先确认你的重构意图,再分析代码库、画依赖图、评估测试覆盖,生成分步计划,逐步改代码并在每步后跑测试验证。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化、抽取或现代化代码时接管。若目标或范围不清楚,它会先反问确认再动手。

say.text: 用 safe 策略重构 src/auth/handler.ts 这个文件
say.note: 先分析代码、建依赖图,再逐步修改

say.text: 把 AuthService 类抽成独立模块,范围限定在 module
say.note: 先查测试覆盖,再产出分步计划

say.text: 清理所有使用已废弃 API 的函数
say.note: 覆盖不足时会先建议补测试

howto.what_en: With this installed, the /refactor command makes Claude confirm your intent, analyze the codebase, build a dependency codemap, assess test coverage, generate a step-by-step plan, then apply changes and run tests after each step.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code. If the target or scope is unclear, it asks clarifying questions first.

say_en.text: Refactor src/auth/handler.ts using the safe strategy
say_en.note: Analyzes the code, maps dependencies, then edits step by step.

say_en.text: Extract the AuthService class into its own module, scope module
say_en.note: Checks test coverage first, then produces a step-by-step plan.

say_en.text: Clean up all functions that use the deprecated API
say_en.note: If coverage is low, it proposes adding tests first.
